verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a run page with a real-time trace view of each task executing, along with its logs. The runs list has configurable columns, including smart columns that pull values from a run's payload, metadata or output by JSON path, and runs can be listed and filtered by status through the management SDK. Retries with exponential backoff and failure alerts are also documented, so the core of a per-run timeline in a team dashboard is delivered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the trace shows per-step inputs, outputs and retry attempts, documented search/filter controls in the dashboard UI itself (only API filtering is shown), and independent hands-on corroboration of the trace view.
